إنذار تسلسل نقاط الطريق

An alarm on navigation systems indicating failure to automatically advance to the next waypoint as programmed in the voyage plan.

Definition

An alarm on navigation systems indicating failure to automatically advance to the next waypoint as programmed in the voyage plan.

Operational example

Waypoint sequencing alarm activated on ECDIS; bridge team, verify next waypoint and update course manually as required.
